name: CoA display patch stream reaches a client that reconnects to its character
contract: Requires CoA.SendDisplayPatches=1. The login stream starts with one SMSG_PATCH_LOADING_SCREENS (0x05F8) row.
A client restarted while its character was still in the world reconnects through
HandlePlayerLoginToCharInWorld, which runs no login hook. Its new session must receive the stream again when
the client reports the extension loaded (CMSG 0x561); a second 0x561 on the same session sends nothing.
Socketless sessions establish the packets, not client rendering.

steps.label: SETUP: the first session is streamed once
The reconnected session is streamed again
A repeated 0x561 on the same session is not streamed
